title: 학교안전사고 예방 및 보상에 관한 법률 시행규칙

rows.source_ko: Ministry of Education ( Education Safety Policy Division ), 044-203-6658
rows.text_en: Ministry of Education ( Education Safety Policy Division ), 044-203-6658

rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Prevention and Compensation of School Safety Accidents and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Prevention and Compensation of School Safety Accidents and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Implementation of School Safety Education) ① The head of a school (hereinafter referred to as the “School Principal”) shall provide the education specified in each of the following subparagraphs to students, faculty and staff, and participants in educational activities pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Act on the Prevention and Compensation of School Safety Accidents (hereinafter referred to as the “ Act”). In this case , the Minister of Education shall separately determine and announce the frequency of education, education hours, instructors, and methods for reporting educational performance results. <Amended Mar. 30, 2012; Jan. 3, 2014; July 21, 2015>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Implementation of School Safety Education) ① The head of a school (hereinafter referred to as the “School Principal”) shall provide the education specified in each of the following subparagraphs to students, faculty and staff, and participants in educational activities pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Act on the Prevention and Compensation of School Safety Accidents (hereinafter referred to as the “ Act”). In this case , the Minister of Education shall separately determine and announce the frequency of education, education hours, instructors, and methods for reporting educational performance results. <Amended Mar. 30, 2012; Jan. 3, 2014; July 21, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. Life safety education to prevent safety accidents that may occur in daily life
rows.text_en: 1. Life safety education to prevent safety accidents that may occur in daily life

rows.source_ko: 2. Traffic safety education to prevent safety accidents that may occur due to means of transportation, etc.
rows.text_en: 2. Traffic safety education to prevent safety accidents that may occur due to means of transportation, etc.

rows.source_ko: 3. Safety education for violence prevention and personal protection
rows.text_en: 3. Safety education for violence prevention and personal protection

rows.source_ko: 4. Safety education for the prevention of drug and cyber addiction
rows.text_en: 4. Safety education for the prevention of drug and cyber addiction

rows.source_ko: 5. Disaster safety education for the prevention and preparedness of fires, disasters, etc.
rows.text_en: 5. Disaster safety education for the prevention and preparedness of fires, disasters, etc.

rows.source_ko: 6. Occupational safety education to prevent safety accidents that may occur at the workplace
rows.text_en: 6. Occupational safety education to prevent safety accidents that may occur at the workplace

rows.source_ko: 7. First Aid Training
rows.text_en: 7. First Aid Training

rows.source_ko: 8. Other education necessary for the prevention of safety accidents
rows.text_en: 8. Other education necessary for the prevention of safety accidents

rows.source_ko: ② Deleted <July 21, 2015>
rows.text_en: ② Deleted <July 21, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ③ The Minister of Education and the Superintendents of Education shall gather opinions from experts in relevant fields and develop educational materials, expand experiential facilities, and provide information on the use of related facilities, etc., in order to enable school principals to efficiently implement school safety education pursuant to Paragraph 1. <Newly added Mar. 30, 2012; Mar. 23, 2013; July 17, 2020>
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Education and the Superintendents of Education shall gather opinions from experts in relevant fields and develop educational materials, expand experiential facilities, and provide information on the use of related facilities, etc., in order to enable school principals to efficiently implement school safety education pursuant to Paragraph 1. <Newly added Mar. 30, 2012; Mar. 23, 2013; July 17, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ④ In Article 8, Paragraph 3 of the Act , “safety education prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Education” refers to the safety education under Paragraph 1. <Newly added July 21, 2015>
rows.text_en: ④ In Article 8, Paragraph 3 of the Act , “safety education prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Education” refers to the safety education under Paragraph 1. <Newly added July 21, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ The specialized educational institutions, organizations, or experts to whom the school principal may entrust safety education pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 4 of the Act are as follows: <Newly added July 21, 2015; July 22, 2025>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The specialized educational institutions, organizations, or experts to whom the school principal may entrust safety education pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 4 of the Act are as follows: <Newly added July 21, 2015; July 22, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. Educational institutions affiliated with the State or local governments that operate safety education courses (including their employees; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph).
rows.text_en: 1. Educational institutions affiliated with the State or local governments that operate safety education courses (including their employees; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph).

rows.source_ko: 2. Korea Road Traffic Authority pursuant to Article 2 of the Korea Road Traffic Authority Act
rows.text_en: 2. Korea Road Traffic Authority pursuant to Article 2 of the Korea Road Traffic Authority Act

rows.source_ko: 3. Korea Fire Safety Institute pursuant to Article 40 of the Framework Act on Firefighting
rows.text_en: 3. Korea Fire Safety Institute pursuant to Article 40 of the Framework Act on Firefighting

rows.source_ko: 4. Other safety experience facilities and safety education institutions recognized by the Minister of Education and the Superintendent of Education as suitable for operating safety education
rows.text_en: 4. Other safety experience facilities and safety education institutions recognized by the Minister of Education and the Superintendent of Education as suitable for operating safety education

rows.source_ko: Article 2-2 (Detailed Payment Standards for Medical Benefits) The detailed payment standards for medical benefits pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Prevention of and Compensation for School Safety Accidents (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”)are as set forth in the Attached Table . <Amended Mar. 25, 2022>
rows.text_en: Article 2-2 (Detailed Payment Standards for Medical Benefits) The detailed payment standards for medical benefits pursuant to Article 14(2) of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Prevention of and Compensation for School Safety Accidents (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) are as set forth in the Attached Table. <Amended Mar. 25, 2022>

rows.source_ko: Article 2-3 (Standards for Payment of Nursing Care Fees) ① The phrase “cases where nursing care by another person is recognized as medically necessary in accordance with standards prescribed by the Ministry of Education Ordinance” in Article 18-2, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree refers to any of the following cases:
rows.text_en: Article 2-3 (Standards for Payment of Nursing Care Fees) ① The phrase “cases where nursing care by another person is recognized as medically necessary in accordance with standards prescribed by the Ministry of Education Ordinance” in Article 18-2, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree refers to any of the following cases:

rows.source_ko: 1. Cases where a person is unable to eat independently due to the loss or inability to use all fingers on both hands.
rows.text_en: 1. Cases where a person is unable to eat independently due to the loss or inability to use all fingers on both hands.

rows.source_ko: 2. Cases where one is unable to perform daily activities independently due to blindness in both eyes, etc.
rows.text_en: 2. Cases where one is unable to perform daily activities independently due to blindness in both eyes, etc.

rows.source_ko: 3. Cases where mental confusion or delirium occurs due to brain damage, making it impossible to perform actions necessary for daily life independently.
rows.text_en: 3. Cases where mental confusion or delirium occurs due to brain damage, making it impossible to perform actions necessary for daily life independently.

rows.source_ko: 4. Cases where there is a significant impediment to treatment, such as inability to communicate due to neurological or mental disorders
rows.text_en: 4. Cases where there is a significant impediment to treatment, such as inability to communicate due to neurological or mental disorders

rows.source_ko: 5. Cases where burns covering 35 percent or more of the body surface area require frequent and appropriate measures.
rows.text_en: 5. Cases where burns covering 35 percent or more of the body surface area require frequent and appropriate measures.

rows.source_ko: 6. 골절로 인한 견인장치 또는 석고붕대 등을 하여 일상생활에 필요한 동작을 혼자 힘으로 할 수 없는 경우
rows.text_en: 6. Cases where the individual is unable to perform daily activities independently due to the use of traction devices or plaster casts resulting from a fracture.

rows.source_ko: 7. 하반신 마비 등으로 배뇨ㆍ배변을 제대로 하지 못하거나 욕창 방지를 위하여 수시로 체위를 변경시킬 필요가 있는 경우
rows.text_en: 7. Cases where proper urination or defecation is impaired due to lower body paralysis, etc., or where it is necessary to change the patient's position frequently to prevent bedsores

rows.source_ko: 8. 질병으로 신체가 몹시 허약하여 일상생활에 필요한 동작을 혼자 힘으로 할 수 없는 경우
rows.text_en: 8. Cases where the body is extremely weak due to illness and the individual is unable to perform movements necessary for daily life on their own.

rows.source_ko: 9. 수술 등으로 일정 기간 거동이 제한되어 일상생활에 필요한 동작을 혼자 힘으로 할 수 없는 경우
rows.text_en: 9. Cases where movement is restricted for a certain period due to surgery or other reasons, making it impossible to perform daily activities independently.

rows.source_ko: 10. 그 밖에 부상ㆍ질병 상태가 제1호부터 제9호까지의 규정에 준하는 경우
rows.text_en: 10. Other cases where the condition of injury or illness is equivalent to the provisions of subparagraphs 1 through 9

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제18조의2제3항에 따른 간병료의 구체적인 지급기준에 관하여는 「산업재해보상보험법 시행규칙」 제13조제1항을 준용한다.
rows.text_en: ② Regarding specific payment standards for nursing care fees pursuant to Article 18-2, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, Article 13, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Rule of the Industrial Accident Compensation Insurance Act shall apply mutatis mutandis.
[Wholly Amended Mar. 25, 2022]

rows.source_ko: 제2조의4(위로금의 청구 및 지급절차) ① 법 제40조의2제1항에 따라 위로금을 받으려는 사람은 별지 제1호서식에 따라 위로금청구서를 작성하여 학교안전공제회(이하 “공제회”라 한다)에 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2-4 (Procedure for Claim and Payment of Consolation Money) ①Any person who wishes to receive consolation money pursuant to Article 40-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall complete a claim form for consolation money in accordance with Form No. 1 attached hereto and submit it to the School Safety Mutual Aid Association (hereinafter referred to as the “Association”).

rows.source_ko: ② 위로금의 지급절차에 대하여는 제7조제3항 및 제4항을 준용한다. 이 경우 “보전비용”은 “위로금”으로 본다.
rows.text_en: ② Paragraphs 3 and 4 of Article 7 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the procedures for the payment of consolation money . In this case, “reimbursement costs” shall be deemed “consolation money.”
[This Article was newly established on March 30, 2012.]

rows.source_ko: 제3조(공제급여의 청구 및 지급 절차 등) ①법 제41조제1항에 따라 공제급여를 받으려는 사람은 별지 제1호서식에 따라 공제급여청구서를 작성하여 공제가입자 또는 공제회에 제출해야 한다. <개정 2012. 3. 30., 2022. 3. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Procedures for Claim and Payment of Mutual Aid Benefits, etc.) ①Any person who intends to receive mutual aid benefits pursuant to Article 41, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall complete a Claim for Mutual Aid Benefits Form in accordance with Annex No. 1 and submit it to the mutual aid subscriber or the Mutual Aid Association. <Amended Mar. 30, 2012; Mar. 25, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 제출하는 공제급여청구서에는 청구이유를 증명할 수 있는 자료(법 제36조제4항제3호에 따른 간병료나 같은 조 제5항에 따른 간병에 소요되는 부대경비에 대한 공제급여청구서인 경우에는 의료기관 입원확인서 등 의무기록과 간병 필요 여부 등에 관하여 「의료법」에 따른 의료인이 발급한 소견서로 한다)를 첨부해야 한다. <신설 2022. 3. 25.>
rows.text_en: ② The claim for deductible benefits submitted pursuant to Paragraph 1 must be accompanied by materials proving the grounds for the claim (in the case of a claim for deductible benefits for nursing care fees pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 4, Subparagraph 3 of the Act or incidental expenses incurred for nursing care pursuant to Paragraph 5 of the same Article, this shall consist of medical records such as a confirmation of hospitalization from a medical institution and a medical opinion issued by a medical professional pursuant to the Medical Service Act regarding the necessity of nursing care, etc. ). <Newly added Mar. 25, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ③공제가입자는 제1항에 따라 공제급여청구서를 받으면 이를 지체 없이 공제회에 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2022. 3. 25.>
rows.text_en: ③ Upon receiving the claim for mutual aid benefits pursuant to Paragraph 1, the mutual aid subscriber shall submit it to the Mutual Aid Association without delay. <Amended Mar. 25, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ④공제회는 공제급여를 지급하는 결정을 내린 경우 그 사실을 공제가입자와 공제급여의 지급을 청구한 자에게 알려야 한다. <개정 2022. 3. 25.>
rows.text_en: ④ If the Mutual Aid Association makes a decision to pay mutual aid benefits, it shall notify the subscriber and the person who claimed the payment of mutual aid benefits of that fact. <Amended Mar. 25, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 제4조(급여원부의 작성) ①공제회는 공제급여를 하였을 때에는 그 급여를 받은 피공제자별 급여원부를 작성하여 갖추어 두어야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Preparation of Benefit Register) ① When the Mutual Aid Association provides mutual aid benefits, it shall prepare and keep a benefit register for each insured person who received the benefits.

rows.source_ko: ②공제회는 공제급여와 관계 있는 자의 청구를 받으면 급여원부를 열람시켜야 하며, 필요하면 증명서를 발부할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② When the Mutual Aid Association receives a request from a person related to the mutual aid benefits, it shall allow them to inspect the benefit ledger, and if necessary, may issue a certificate.

rows.source_ko: 제5조(공제급여의 제한) 법 제43조제4항에서 “교육부령으로 정하는 기간”이란 공제가입자가 공제료의 납부통지를 받은 날부터 30일을 말한다. <개정 2008. 3. 4., 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 7. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Restriction on Mutual Aid Benefits) In Article 43, Paragraph 4 of the Act , the term “period prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Education” refers to 30 days from the date the mutual aid subscriber receives notice of payment of mutual aid premiums. <Amended Mar. 4, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013; July 22, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제5조의2(사고발생통지) 법 제44조제2항에 따라 공제가입자가 학교안전사고가 발생하였음을 통지하는 경우에는 별지 제2호서식에 따라 신고서를 작성하여 공제회에 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5-2 (Notification of Occurrence of Accident) In accordance with Article 44, Paragraph 2 of the Act , if a member of the mutual aid association notifies that a school safety accident has occurred, they must complete a report form in accordance with Form No. 2 attached hereto and submit it to the mutual aid association.
[Wholly Amended July 22, 2025]

rows.source_ko: 제6조(부당이득의 환수) ①공제회는 법 제46조에 따라 부당이득을 환수하기로 결정하였을 때에는 지체 없이 납부 책임이 있는 자에게 그 금액을 납부할 것을 통지하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Recovery of Unjust Enrichment) ① When the Mutual Aid Association decides to recover unjust enrichment pursuant to Article 46 of the Act , it shall notify the person responsible for payment to pay the amount without delay.

rows.source_ko: ②제1항에 따라 통지를 받은 자는 통지 받은 날부터 30일 이내에 그 금액을 내야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② A person who has received notice pursuant to Paragraph 1 must pay the amount within 30 days from the date of receiving the notice.

rows.source_ko: 제7조(비용의 보전) ①법 제48조제2항에 따라 보전하는 비용(이하 “보전비용”이라 한다)은 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Reimbursement of Costs) ① Costs reimbursed pursuant to Article 48, Paragraph 2 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “reimbursement costs”) are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 손해의 방지와 경감을 위하여 지출한 손해방지ㆍ경감비용 및 긴급조치 비용의 전부 또는 일부
rows.text_en: 1. All or part of the costs for damage prevention and mitigation and emergency measures incurred to prevent and mitigate damage.

rows.source_ko: 2. 남으로부터 손해배상을 받을 수 있는 권리의 보전과 행사를 위하여 지출한 필요 비용 또는 유익한 비용의 전부 또는 일부
rows.text_en: 2. All or part of necessary or beneficial expenses incurred for the preservation and exercise of the right to receive compensation for damages from a third party

rows.source_ko: 3. 학교안전사고와 관련한 민사ㆍ형사소송의 비용 및 공탁대부금의 전부 또는 일부
rows.text_en: 3. All or part of the costs of civil and criminal proceedings and deposit loans related to school safety accidents

rows.source_ko: ②보전비용을 받으려는 자는 별지 제1호서식에 따라 보전비용청구서를 작성하여 공제가입자를 거쳐 공제회에 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② A person who intends to receive reimbursement costs must prepare a claim for reimbursement costs in accordance with Form No. 1 attached hereto and submit it to the mutual aid association through the mutual aid subscriber.

rows.source_ko: ③제2항에 따라 보전비용의 청구를 받은 공제회는 청구 받은 날부터 14일 이내에 보전비용의 지급 여부를 결정하여야 한다. 조사의 필요성 등 정당한 사유가 있어 14일 이내에 공제급여의 지급 여부 결정이 어려운 때에는 추가로 14일을 연장할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ The mutual aid association that receives a claim for reimbursement costs pursuant to Paragraph 2 shall decide whether to pay the reimbursement costs within 14 days from the date of receipt of the claim. If it is difficult to decide whether to pay the mutual aid benefits within 14 days due to justifiable reasons, such as the necessity of an investigation, the period may be extended by an additional 14 days.

rows.source_ko: ④공제회가 보전비용을 지급하기로 결정한 경우에는 지체 없이 보전비용을 청구한 자에게 보전비용을 지급하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ If the mutual aid association decides to pay the reimbursement costs, it shall pay the reimbursement costs to the person who claimed the reimbursement costs without delay.

rows.source_ko: 제8조(공제료에 대한 이의 신청) 법 제49조제5항에 따라 통보된 공제료에 대하여 이의가 있는 공제가입자는 통보를 받은 날부터 14일 이내에 별지 제3호서식에 따라 공제료 이의 신청서를 작성하여 공제회에 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2012. 3. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Application for Objection to Insurance Premiums) Any subscriber who has an objection to the insurance premiums notified pursuant to Article 49, Paragraph 5 of the Act shall complete and submit an Application for Objection to Insurance Premiums in accordance with Form No. 3 attached hereto to the Mutual Aid Association within 14 days from the date of receiving the notification. <Amended Mar. 30, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 제9조(공제료의 납부) ①공제회는 법 제50조제1항에 따라 학교별 공제료를 정하여 매년 4월 1일까지 공제가입자에게 통보하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Payment of Contributions) ① The Contribution Association shall determine the contribution for each school in accordance with Article 50, Paragraph 1 of the Act and notify the contributors by April 1 of each year.

rows.source_ko: ②제1항에 따라 공제가입자는 공제료를 매년 4월 30일까지 공제회에 내야 한다. 다만, 법 제12조 단서에 따라 공제회에 가입한 공제가입자는 가입한 날부터 30일 이내에 공제료를 내야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② In accordance with Paragraph 1, a member of the mutual aid association must pay the mutual aid premium to the association by April 30 of each year. However, a member of the mutual aid association who has joined pursuant to the proviso of Article 12 of the Act must pay the mutual aid premium within 30 days from the date of joining.

rows.source_ko: 제9조의2(기금의 지원 등) ① 교육감은 법 제51조제3항에 따라 학교폭력 피해학생의 치료비 등에 소요되는 예상경비를 매년 4월 30일까지 공제회에 지원하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 9-2 (Support for Fund, etc.) ① The Superintendent of Education shall provide the Mutual Aid Association with the estimated expenses required for the treatment costs, etc. of students who are victims of school violence, in accordance with Article 51, Paragraph 3 of the Act, by April 30 of each year.

rows.source_ko: ② 공제회는 다음 연도 1월 말일까지 정산하여 그 결과를 교육감에게 통보하여야 하며, 집행잔액은 이월금에 포함하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Mutual Aid Association shall settle accounts by the end of January of the following year and notify the Superintendent of Education of the results, and any unspent balance shall be included in the carried-over funds.
[This Article was newly established on March 30, 2012.]

rows.source_ko: 제9조의3(집행 기준 등) ① 법 제53조제2항에 따라 학교폭력 피해학생의 상담 및 치료기간은 2년으로 하고, 일시보호의 기간은 30일로 한다. 다만, 추가적인 치료 등을 위하여 학교폭력 피해학생 및 보호자가 요청하는 경우에는 법 제58조제1항에 따른 학교안전공제보상심사위원회의 심의를 거쳐 1년의 범위에서 상담 및 치료기간을 연장할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 9-3 (Execution Standards, etc.) ① Pursuant to Article 53, Paragraph 2 of the Act , the period of counseling and treatment for a student victim of school violence shall be two years, and the period of temporary protection shall be 30 days. However, if the student victim of school violence and their guardian request additional treatment, the period of counseling and treatment may be extended within the range of one year following deliberation by the School Safety Insurance Compensation Review Committee pursuant to Article 58, Paragraph 1 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 학교폭력 피해학생 및 보호자는 별지 제4호서식에 따라 치료비 등 청구서를 작성하여 공제회에 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Students who are victims of school violence and their guardians pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall complete and submit a claim form for medical expenses, etc., in accordance with Form No. 4 attached hereto to the Mutual Aid Association.

rows.source_ko: ③ 공제회는 학교폭력 피해학생에 대한 치료비 등의 지급을 결정하기 전에 학교장이 별지 제5호서식에 따라 작성하여 제출한 자료 등을 통하여 사실관계를 확인하여야 하고, 필요한 경우에는 관련 전문가의 자문을 받을 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ Before deciding on the payment of medical expenses, etc. to a student who is a victim of school violence, the Association shall verify the facts through materials, etc. prepared and submitted by the school principal in accordance with Form No. 5 attached hereto , and may seek advice from relevant experts if necessary.

rows.source_ko: ④ 공제회는 학교폭력 피해학생에 대한 치료비 등의 지급을 결정한 때에는 지급하기 전에 학교폭력 가해학생 및 보호자에게 알려야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ When the Mutual Aid Association decides to pay medical expenses, etc. to a student who is a victim of school violence, it must notify the student who committed school violence and their guardian before making the payment.
[This Article was newly established on March 30, 2012.]

rows.source_ko: 제10조(기금운용계획) ①법 제55조에 따른 학교안전공제및사고예방기금(이하 “기금”이라 한다)의 운용계획에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Fund Management Plan) ① The management plan of the School Safety Mutual Aid and Accident Prevention Fund (hereinafter referred to as the “Fund”) pursuant to Article 55 of the Act shall include the following matters:

rows.source_ko: 1. 기금의 수입 및 지출에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the income and expenditure of the fund

rows.source_ko: 2. 해당연도의 사업계획 및 자금계획에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the business plan and financial plan for the relevant year

rows.source_ko: 3. 전년도 이월자금의 처리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the handling of funds carried over from the previous year

rows.source_ko: 4. 적립금에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning accumulated points

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 기금 운용에 필요한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Other matters necessary for the operation of the fund

rows.source_ko: ②공제회는 제1항에 따라 기금운용계획을 수립하여 매 사업연도 시작 1개월 전까지 교육감에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The mutual aid association shall formulate a fund management plan in accordance with Paragraph 1 and submit it to the Superintendent of Education by one month prior to the start of each fiscal year.
Article 11 Deleted <Mar. 30, 2012>

rows.text_en: Article 3 (Timing of Fund Support)  In relation to the expenses supported by the Superintendent of Education to the Mutual Aid Association pursuant to the amended provisions of Article 9-2, Paragraph 1, expenses corresponding to the year 2012 shall be paid by December 31, 2012.
